comments.author: @wayneprice6731
comments.text: I closed on my homestead 55 months ago, locking-in a fixed interest rate of only 2.25%. My homestead includes two dwellings; the main domicile is 75 years old (pier-and-beam), and the bungalow is about 30 years old. The previous owners must've loved this homestead, because it's been beautifully maintained. It includes two dwellings totaling 3,600 square feet, 16 rooms including four bedrooms, three full bathrooms, two kitchen/dining room areas, two laundry rooms with full-size appliances, two offices, two garages and a carport, four porches/patios, four yuge workshops, five fenced yards, etc — all on 1.25 acres in a clean, quiet, safe, predominantly senior-citizen neighborhood. And my total mortgage payment is only $1,000 including homeowners and flood insurance premiums. My total utility bill (electric, natural gas, water/trash collection) averages about $250 per month. Because my mortgage payment is so low, I've been paying 250% of the scheduled mortgage, thereby enabling me to pay it off completely within the next seven years — 18.5 years ahead of schedule! So, the moral of the story is, "If you accomplish due diligence BEFORE deciding to purchase a homestead, it'll be the best decision of your entire life!" 😊
